prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured's vehicle owner regarding a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Claimant reports being rear-ended while stopped at a marked space. No police report filed on scene. Photos requested.

Entry 2: Claimant reports neck strain following the impact and states symptoms began within an hour. Advised claimant to seek medical evaluation and keep all treatment records. Claimant indicates they are not represented by an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly.

Entry 3: Recorded statement obtained from claimant. Describes vehicle damage to rear bumper and trunk area. Other driver acknowledged fault at the scene per claimant account. Other driver's insurer contacted to confirm coverage and open a liability file.

Entry 4: Reviewed submitted photos and repair estimate. Damage consistent with reported impact speed. Claimant asked about rental vehicle coverage; explained the terms of the policy and the process for a rental authorization. No dispute raised on property damage so far.

Entry 5: Follow-up call to claimant regarding medical documentation for neck strain. Claimant has scheduled an appointment with a provider and will forward records once received. File set to pending medical review. Next follow-up scheduled for when records arrive.
